name: Ikemen Bakumatsu ◆ Unmei no Koi
original_name: イケメン幕末◆運命の恋
source:
In Japan, the dawn of a new era was approaching.

You find yourself suddenly snatched from your peaceful life in modern days to a different time, and a landscape unlike you've ever seen. Caught in the center of revolution, which side will you choose? Even if for a mere moment, whose arms will you find sanctuary in? Your romance awaits you in the past. Do you believe in destiny?

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.bks.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在日本，新时代的曙光即将到来。

你发现自己突然脱离了现代平静的生活，来到了一个不同的时空，以及一个你从未见过的风景。陷入革命的中心，你会选择哪一边？即使只有片刻，你会在谁的怀抱中找到庇护？你的浪漫在过去等待着你。你相信命运吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.bks.en]Google Play[/url]]
